predicted_cif.description: Absolute path to the model-predicted structure (mmCIF format).

reference_cif.description: Absolute path to the reference/ground-truth structure (mmCIF format).

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from upstream tools. Requires at least two items: the first's structure_path is treated as `predicted_cif`, the second's as `reference_cif`.

metrics.description: Requested evaluation metrics. `lddt` is per-residue LDDT (intrinsic quality); `dockq` is the DockQ score for protein-protein interfaces.

a.description: Chain id of side A of the interface pair.

b.description: Chain id of side B of the interface pair.

chain_pairs.description: Optional list of chain-pair selections to restrict DockQ scoring. Null evaluates every cross-chain interface.
